title: Stationary-wave formation and structure
design_rationale: Separate graphical stationary-wave formation from the later measurement procedure so nodes and antinodes have physical meaning first.
concepts_taught: explain the formation of a stationary wave using a graphical method, and identify nodes and antinodes
understand how wavelength may be determined from the positions of nodes or antinodes of a stationary wave

next_module_can_assume: explain the formation of a stationary wave using a graphical method, and identify nodes and antinodes
understand how wavelength may be determined from the positions of nodes or antinodes of a stationary wave
next_module_must_not_assume: show an understanding of experiments that demonstrate stationary waves using microwaves, stretched strings and air columns (it will be assumed that end corrections are negligible; knowledge of the concept of end corrections is not required)
